businesses.business: local news publishing and media services

offering_description.value: Lee Enterprises publishes local news in print and online for readers across the United States. It sells advertising and digital marketing services to businesses and provides cloud publishing software to other media organizations.

primary_products.value: print and digital newspapers; community publications; cloud publishing software

primary_services.value: print and digital advertising; digital marketing campaign management; commercial printing and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: local readers and newspaper subscribers; B2B: local and regional advertisers, marketing agencies, newspaper publishers and broadcasters; B2G: local government agencies placing public notices

end_markets.value: local news and information; local business advertising; media publishing and broadcasting

revenue_model.value: advertising: print and digital ad placements and paid public notices; subscription: print delivery, digital news access and cloud publishing software; service fees: managed digital marketing, commercial printing and delivery; product sales: single copies of print newspapers
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: other: produces and edits local journalism for readers and sells access to those audiences to advertisers; service provider: runs marketing campaigns for businesses and prints and delivers publications for other publishers; software / platform: develops tools for publishers and broadcasters to manage, publish and monetize digital content

geography_served.value: US national: local media markets across the United States, with publishing software sold nationally

specialization.value: related lines: local news publishing, advertising and digital marketing, commercial printing and delivery, and media publishing software

distribution_channels.value: online: news websites and mobile apps with self-serve subscriptions; direct sales: sales teams serving advertisers, marketing clients and media organizations; third-party retail: stores selling single copies of local newspapers; other: print newspaper home delivery routes
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; third-party retail; other

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general copyright, advertising and consumer protection rules apply to publishing and subscriptions

notes: The extent of publishing software sales outside the United States is unclear.
